title: One Byte, One Token: Byteifying a 27B Hybrid-Attention LLM with Self-Generated Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.13607v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Byte-level BPE fragments Chinese text (for Qwen3.8 on Chinese Wikipedia, 3.84 bytes per token on average; 64% of tokens are single characters) and hides spelling from the model. We ask whether an already-trained 27B subword model can be converted directly into a pure byte-level model (one byte, one token), without a patching structure or a local encoder, while keeping most of its ability. Starting from Qwen3.8-27B (48 Gated DeltaNet layers + 16 full-attention layers), we shrink the vocabulary from 248,320 to 384 entries (the 256 byte symbols already in the BPE vocabulary plus special ids), leave every other weight untouched, and continue training in a two-stage curriculum (encoding first, then reading) on 4.77 GB of supervised bytes: all dialogue/behavioral supervision is generated on-policy by the original model itself (character dictionary, word dictionary, general dialogue, coding sessions), and knowledge reading uses encyclopedia tex

translated_title: 一字节，一个词元：利用自生成数据将27B混合注意力大语言模型字节化
translated_abstract: 字节级BPE会将中文文本碎片化（在中文维基百科上，Qwen3.8平均每个词元对应3.84字节；64%的词元是单个字符），并对模型隐藏了拼写信息。我们探究是否可以将一个已经训练好的27B子词模型直接转换为纯字节级模型（一个字节，一个词元），而无需补丁结构或局部编码器，同时保留其大部分能力。从Qwen3.8-27B（48层Gated DeltaNet层加16层全注意力层）出发，我们将词表从248,320个条目缩减至384个（BPE词表中已有的256个字节符号加上特殊标识），保持其他所有权重不变，并在4.77 GB的监督字节数据上进行两阶段课程训练（先编码，后阅读）：所有对话/行为监督数据均由原始模型自身以在线策略方式生成（包括字符词典、词语词典、通用对话、编程会话），知识阅读部分则使用百科文本。
tldr: 研究者通过将词表缩减至384个条目（含256个字节符号），并利用原始模型自生成的4.77GB在线策略监督数据进行两阶段课程训练，成功将270亿参数的Qwen3.8混合注意力模型直接转换为纯字节级模型，无需补丁结构或局部编码器即可保留其大部分原有能力。
en_tdlr: Researchers directly converted the 27B hybrid-attention Qwen3.8 model into a pure byte-level model by shrinking the vocabulary to 384 entries and continuing training on 4.77GB of self-generated on-policy supervision data, preserving most capabilities without patching structures or local encoders.
